login.title: Kunjila kwamweenzinyina
login.welcome: Mwatambulwa alimwi! Njila kuti ukonzye kweendelezya zyintu zyako.
login.heroTitle: Komezya makwebo aako aakuula maanda alubono loonse ndoleta
login.heroIntro: Inzila yomwe yakulembesya basikuula kuli basikuyaka, bamba mpuwo yabasikuula bako mpawo ubatobelezye kusikila kukubhuka.

protect.title: Kukwabililwa ziindi zyobile
protect.text: Musololi wako ulazumanana kuba wako kwachiindi chakukwabililwa, aboobo taakwe umbi uukonzya kulomba kasitoma nguwenya.

track.title: Tobelezya ntaamu zyoonse
track.text: Langa chiimo chasikusololela umwi awumwi alwaano loonse, kuzwa kukusaanguna kusikila kukubbuku.

handover.title: Chikwelete aawo nowakabhuka
handover.text: Aawo kasitoma nabbuku, mpuwo ilapegwa kuli sikuyaka mpawo webo ulilembedwe kuti nduwe mweenzinyina.

login.secure: Kunjila munzila iikwabilidwe - makani aabasikuula bako alazumanana kuba aamaseseke

signup.title: Kulembesya mweenzinyina
signup.intro: Panga akaunti yako kuti utalike kulilembya akubamba basikuula bako.
